description: Get a checkout link for Himalayas Plus (US$9 a month), which covers tailored resumes and cover letters for every job, voice mock interviews for a specific job (30 minutes a month, each scored with feedback on clarity, examples and pacing), new job matches between sessions (get_new_matches), the user's profile shown first to employers searching Himalayas talent, and a career coach. The user opens the link and pays on Stripe themselves. Plus is optional: applying through Himalayas is free. Never enter payment details or make up a link. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.
name: get_plus_checkout_link
